style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: Eastern Front Planes Pack Paradox Steam Released on 2021-06-03. The Eastern Front Content Pack adds over 50 new aircraft models to fight it out in the skies over Eastern Europe. Germany: Adds 21 plane models; A fleet of Luftwaffe designs, including the feared Ju-87 Stuka, the ubiquitous He-111 medium bomber and three hypothetical carrier launched planes. Hungary: Adds 5 plane models; The biplane WM-16 bomber and the experimental RMI-8-X/V fighter are now in game with three other designs. Poland: Adds 8 plane models; Including the highly advanced PZL.37 Łoś bomber, the prototype PZL.56 Kania fighter and PZL.46 Sum light bomber. Romania: Adds 4 plane models; The scrappy Romanian air force is represented by three IAR fighter designs and the IAR 37 light bomber. Soviet Union: Adds 12 plane models; A dozen planes from the Red Army Air Forces, including the “varnished coffin” LaGG-3 fighter, the celebrated Il-2 close air support plane, and the Tu-4 Cold War strategic bomber. Yugoslavia: Adds 4 plane models; The Yugoslav air force is represented by the Czech designed BH-33, the prototype R-313 fighter-bomber, and two more planes.

Soviet Union 2D Art Content Creator Pack Paradox Steam Released on 2024-06-10. Paradox Interactive has teamed up with talented modders from the Hearts of Iron IV community to release a content pack with new art assets for the Soviet Union. Ethan “156” Mayer and Aqeel “Uncharted” Mughal, Head Developers on the popular World Ablaze mod for the game, have created new icons and weapons art that reflect the historical designs and art of one of the key players in World War II. A portion of the revenue generated by this Content Creator Pack goes directly to the creators - by buying it you are supporting HOI modders. Soviet Union Community Content Pack includes over 300 new 2D assets: 61 new tank icons 35 new plane icons 32 new ship icons 4 new pieces of infantry art 11 new artillery icons 3 new motorised infantry icons 5 new mechanised infantry icons 3 new armoured car icons 1 new support equipment icon 3 new train icons 23 new icons for the Soviet industry focus tree 54 new icons for the Soviet military focus tree 93 new icons for the Soviet political focus tree 38 new icons for Soviet National Spirit

Prototype Vehicles Paradox Steam Released on 2025-05-15. This unit pack includes unit art for wartime vehicles that never saw a production line. From advanced warplane designs to theoretical battle vehicles, this unit pack adds even more alternate history flavour with technological marvels and oddities that could have changed the course of the war.

Warships of the Pacific Paradox Steam Released on 2026-03-17 Command the seas with Warships of the Pacific, a Cosmetic Pack for Hearts of Iron IV. Warships of the Pacific includes unit art for new seafaring vessels; from nimble destroyers to mighty battleships, representing iconic warships from multiple nations across the globe. This pack includes 30 models of ships from the Pacific theatre including: One Republican Chinese light cruiser, the Ning-Hai Eight Commonwealth ship models, including the carrier Illustrious and the submarine Trenchant Eleven Japanese ships models, including the battleship Kongo, the carrier Shinano and the unique I-400 Sen Toku submarine carrier One People’s Republic of China destroyer, the Anshan Two Soviet submarine models - the Shchuka and the M49 Seven American models, including battleships such as Nevada and Tennessee, as well as escort carriers like Casablanca
